description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentDao class, which manages database interactions related to employee dependents in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee dependents, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing employee dependent entities, providing CRUD operations and search functionalities with pagination support.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves all dependents for a given employee number, ordered by name ascending.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Fetches a specific dependent by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingDependentIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns existing dependent sequence IDs for a specific employee, filtered by provided IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves an employee dependent, assigning a new sequence number if not explicitly set.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for an employee based on provided sequence IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for dependents based on filter parameters, returning results with pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator with query based on search filter parameters, including sorting and filtering.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search filter parameters.
